evidence_items.title: Devansh144/SWE-bench_Pro
evidence_items.summary: SWE-bench Pro V2 SWE-bench Pro is a benchmark of long-horizon software engineering tasks drawn from real pull requests in 11 open-source repositories (Go, Python, JavaScript, TypeScript). Each task gives an agent a repository at a base commit plus a PR description with explicit requirements and interfaces; the agent's patch is graded by hidden fail-to-pass and pass-to-pass tests in a pristine container. V2 (2026-09-22) is the default config: 642 tasks (go 256, python 237, js 145… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/Devansh144/SWE-bench_Pro.
